locations.note: Sangre del Toro: Marlowe crosses the desert to a freighter lost in 1949 and finds the Operation Aurora papers and a scalar component inside.
Operation Aurora: the 1944 prologue, US commandos landing on an unnamed Japanese island in the Sea of Japan to seize a scientist and a scalar weapon.
Cold War: Bad Company backs up a US intelligence operation in Russian territory, watches Kirilenko execute the agents, and seizes what turns out to be a dummy scalar weapon.

Heart of Darkness and Upriver: Bad Company follows the CIA's Aguire up a jungle river and rescues him from the militia, then flies up into the snowbound Andes to bring down the satellite holding his intel.

Heavy Metal and High Value Target: riding south toward Chile with a US armoured column, the squad hunts Kirilenko in a settlement near the Talinay wind farms, but he slips away and leaves the Sangre del Toro's manifest behind.
Airborne: the finale aboard the weapon's aircraft, which Marlowe brings down over Texas.
Valparaíso: a multiplayer map down the port's steep streets.
Arica Harbor: a multiplayer map through the border town's harbour.
Panama Canal: a multiplayer map around the locks.
Port Valdez: the oil terminal at the end of the pipeline, a multiplayer map.
White Pass and Nelson Bay: snowbound Alaskan multiplayer maps near the Russian border.
The Vietnam expansion: Phu Bai Valley, Hill 137, Cao Son Temple, Vantage Point and Operation Hastings, 1960s battles in the jungle.

routes.name: Bad Company
routes.note: From the dummy weapon in Russia to the Bolivian jungle and the Andes, south to the Talinay wind farms and a ship wrecked in the desert, then a free fall over Texas from the Scalar's cargo plane.
